title: Osoyoos Wine Tour Full Day Guided With 5 Wineries
blurb:
Welcome to your Osoyoos Wine tour! As far south as one can venture in the Okanagan, Osoyoos offers unique terroir, endless sunshine, handcrafted wines and an intimate experience within one of Canada’s most iconic wine regions. This action packed 7 hour wine experience offers access to the best of the Okanagan wine culture in the heat of the desert! The further south you go, the bigger and bolder the reds get! With 5 exceptional wineries visited over the course of the day, the Osoyoos Wine Tour offers something for all wine lovers. 

Located in the southern most part of the Okanagan, this full day (~7 hours) Osoyoos Wine Tour offers access to the region's most sought after wineries and includes a lunch stop with reservations at a winery restaurant.
